citations.assessment: The digital Bavli explicitly uses Shimon he-Hasid.
Rosh Hashanah attests this reporting chain, with the reporting speaker titled Rav in the checked witness.
The pinned Bibi entry expressly records Dela and Gula, with Giddel in its own Bava Kamma reference. The check confirms Heilprin’s records of the forms without merging them.
Bava Kamma directly has Rav Bibi bar Giddel report in the name of Shimon Hasida.
The juxtaposed Chullin paragraphs explicitly name Huna bar Torta and his coming before Shimon the Pious.
The Yevamot tradition has the exact Huna bar Bizna formula. The Hana chain has separate attestations.
The Berakhot passage names Rav Hana bar Bizna. Rosh Hashanah also attests a Hana formula and Chullin names the unrelated Huna bar Torta in its own narrative.
The named Yerushalmi halakhah has a direct Yonah-in-Shimon-Hasida chain about pecked fruit.
